description: Module 02 — v1 disaster. Connects Claude Code (or any agentic assistant) to the workshop's shared PGlite (booted from pglite/) via the deprecated official @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres@0.6.2 — the one Anthropic archived in May 2025 after the Datadog Security Labs SQL-injection write-up. Faithful late-2024 setup, ready to bite. The database itself lives in pglite/ so this folder doesn't expose seed.sql to participants' agents.
